title: Ghar hussain ka hai
body:
sharaf ke shehr mein har baam o dar hussain ka hai
zamane bhar ke gharano mein ghar hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
furaate waqte rawan dekh suye maqtal dekh
jo sar baland hai ab bhi wo sar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen kha gayi kya kya baland o baala darakht
hara bhara hai jo ab bhi shajar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
sawaale bayyate shamsheer par jawaz bahot
magar jawab wohi mohtabar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
mohabbaton ke hawalon mein zikr aane laga
ye fazl bhi to mere haal par hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
huzoore shaafa e mehshar ali kahe ke ye shaks
gunaah gaar bahot hai magar hussain ka hai
sharaf ke shehr mein...
author: Iftikhar Arif
